functional.meaning: Functional verification observations; verification cases do not expand the six research workloads.

correction.reason: Single authorized common correction: GPL_CELL_PADDING and DPL_CELL_PADDING 1 to 2 reserve one actual site per side under the pinned integer-half Tcl, addressing legalization space after larger-array final antenna failure; no other recipe field changes and no ranking/performance selection.

tie_policy.pairwise: If either layer ties, tied_or_indeterminate; otherwise equal order is preserved and opposite order reversed.
tie_policy.top1_agreement: Identical unique winners count toward agreement/6; any multiwinner set is explicitly indeterminate.
tie_policy.winner_set: Every configuration numerically tied with the minimum; sorted by array size.

wavefront_example.meaning: Explanatory trace regenerated from accepted input and unchanged token model; not a new benchmark or physical result.
